description: This file contains the implementation of the PEAR package, including the PEAR core class, error handling classes (PEAR_Error), and related utility functions such as error handling, extension loading, and destructor emulation. It serves as the foundational source code for the PEAR PHP extension repository, defining core mechanisms for error management and class behaviors within the PEAR ecosystem.

classes.name: PEAR
classes.description: A foundational class providing error handling, extension loading, and destructor emulation mechanisms for PEAR components, allowing subclasses to inherit standardized behaviors and error management strategies.

classes.name: PEAR_Error
classes.description: A class representing error objects within PEAR, encapsulating error message, code, mode, callback, and debug information, supporting multiple error handling modes including print, trigger, callback, die, or exception.

methods.name: PEAR
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PEAR object, registers it for destructor emulation if applicable, and sets up class-specific error handling.

methods.name: _PEAR
methods.description: Destructor emulation method, called during object destruction, for cleanup and debugging purposes.

methods.name: getStaticProperty
methods.description: Simulates static class properties, providing a way to store and retrieve class-wide variables.

methods.name: registerShutdownFunc
methods.description: Registers a shutdown function to be called at script termination, ensuring cleanup tasks are performed.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks whether a given value is a PEAR_Error object, optionally matching a specific message or code.

methods.name: setErrorHandling
methods.description: Configures how the PEAR object handles errors, supporting modes like return, print, trigger, die, callback, or exception.

methods.name: expectError
methods.description: Pushes specified error codes onto a stack of expected errors, influencing how errors are handled during execution.

methods.name: popExpect
methods.description: Removes the most recently expected error codes from the stack.

methods.name: _checkDelExpect
methods.description: Removes a specific error code from the expected errors stack if present.

methods.name: delExpect
methods.description: Deletes error codes from the expected errors stack, handling individual or multiple codes.

methods.name: raiseError
methods.description: Creates and returns a PEAR_Error object based on provided message, code, mode, and other parameters, applying global or object-specific error handling configurations.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: Simplified error-raising method that internally calls raiseError with minimal parameters.

methods.name: staticPushErrorHandling
methods.description: Pushes current error handling mode and options onto a stack, then sets new modes.

methods.name: staticPopErrorHandling
methods.description: Restores previous error handling mode and options from the stack.

methods.name: pushErrorHandling
methods.description: Overrides current error handling mode temporarily, saving previous modes for restoration.

methods.name: popErrorHandling
methods.description: Restores previous error handling mode from stack.

methods.name: loadExtension
methods.description: Attempts to load a PHP extension in an OS-independent manner.
